relations.evidence_basis: Agent-turn event_index_start/event_index_end contains the source Arena action event index.
Realization BehaviorEvent explicitly carries proposal BehaviorEvent in parent_event_refs.
Realized message action and read ledger share the same message_id.
Realized invocation action and invocation-delivery message read share the same message_id.
Realized invocation action and invocation read ledger share the same invocation_id.
Agent turn input_message_ids explicitly contains the read message_id.
Agent turn input_invocation_ids explicitly contains the read invocation_id.
Agent runtime_snapshot shared_state_metadata carries the exact source Arena event_index and writer for the visible state key.
Agent runtime_snapshot final_state carries the same state_id and revision_count as the latest source-backed final-state version event.
Revision final_state_before has the same state_id and revision_count as a preceding realized final-state version event.
Finalize final_state_before has the same state_id and revision_count as a preceding realized final-state version event.

non_claims: A structural lineage edge does not establish semantic adoption.
Visibility does not prove that the model attended to or relied on the visible state.
Message or invocation consumption does not prove agreement with its content.
Lineage does not by itself establish Authority Penetration.
Temporal ancestry is not a psychological explanation of the model's reasoning.
